description: Shared Xena Studios settings. Submodules in upstream/ and panel/ are updated by hand, after the version matrix passes, so Renovate leaves them alone. It still clones upstream/Pumpkin, read only: the workspace names path dependencies in it, and Cargo.lock can't be regenerated without them.

packageRules.description: A 0.x minor bump of a crate is a breaking release and usually needs code changes, so those get their own PR instead of riding with the other non-major updates.
Container images are exercised by the network and monitoring checks, not the Rust job; a separate group keeps a crate break from holding them up.

Patch and digest bumps of images and actions merge themselves once every check passes. A group merges itself only when all of its updates are of this kind; minor and major bumps, and every crate, wait for a review.
